people.name: Lazarus
people.line: Brother of Mary and Martha; raised from the dead

people.name: Martha
people.line: Sister of Mary and Lazarus, hosted Jesus.

translations.web: So they made him a supper there. Martha served, but Lazarus was one of those who sat at the table with him.
translations.bsb: So they hosted a dinner for Jesus there. Martha served, and Lazarus was among those reclining at the table with Him.
translations.kjv: There they made him a supper; and Martha served: but Lazarus was one of them that sat at the table with him.
translations.asv: So they made him a supper there: and Martha served; but Lazarus was one of them that sat at meat with him.
